d:
Pitru Paksha mein bachchon ke liye nani-dadi wali Daliya Lapsi Ghee, gud aur daliya se, bina doodh, bina mawa!
Poonam Devnani ki is Masala Kitchen recipe mein Gehun ke Daliya ki Lapsi banana seekhiye, nani-dadi wali vidhi se.
Gehun ke daliya ki lapsi, cooker mein, khila-khila
Daliya chhaanne aur ghee mein golden bhoonne ki trick
1 cup daliya : 3 cup pani ka perfect ratio
Gud aur cheeni ka balance, kesar, jaiphal, elaichi ka swad
Comment karein: lapsi mein gud daalte hain ya cheeni? Aapke yahan Pitru Paksha mein ye banti hai?
